design: INDIVIDUAL 01: a very old tall lean council elder with parchment-grey freckled hide, broad flat rear skull and a nicked upper mandibular tusk. Waist-long sparse silver scalp tendrils held with three heavy bronze cylinders, no head crown. Three long narrow rank stoles over a charcoal and muted purple split robe; large stone-and-bronze collar with a single central square. Holds a thin closed council tablet against one side and extends the other open clawed hand in calm deliberation. Narrow upright silhouette, visible bare clawed feet.
